experiences.position: Head of Product Design and Delivery
experiences.description:
As Head of Product Design & Delivery at Fetch, I lead cross-functional teams spanning Product Design, Project Delivery, and Technology Planning to bring innovative software and hardware solutions to market. I drive the full product lifecycle — from concept through launch — ensuring execution is timely, aligned, and impactful.

Partnering closely with Product Strategy, Engineering, and Commercial teams, I turn roadmap priorities into delivered outcomes that meet business objectives and user expectations. I oversee end-to-end delivery, operational readiness, and ongoing optimisation, building a high-performance culture grounded in collaboration, accountability, and customer insight.

By aligning teams, streamlining execution, and removing delivery blockers, I ensure Fetch products ship at pace, at quality, and with purpose. In practice, this remit extends beyond functional leadership into company-wide operations — partnering with the C-suite to drive strategic execution and organisational performance.

* ViacomCBS: Coordinated rollout of 10 All Access Fetch integration (Dec 2019) and Paramount+ relaunch (Aug 2021), aligning cross-functional teams to meet deadlines and quality standards.

* Oversaw continuous updates and feature delivery for 7plus, 9Now, 10Play, ABC iview, and SBS On Demand apps, ensuring seamless integration and platform stability.

* Led the launch of Virtual Playlist Channels (July 2019), a strategic initiative delivering Free-to-Air catch-up content, driving increased viewer engagement through innovative linear content curation.

* Ensured effective stakeholder communication and risk management across programs, enabling timely issue resolution and successful product releases.

* Delivered the AsiaFlix prototype standalone mobile apps (iOS & Android) for internal launch (2014), supporting innovation and market testing.

* Provided ongoing support and feature management for the Fetch Companion apps (iOS & Android) until October 2016 product updates.
